title: Blackout Protocol
description: A coordinated traffic flood is disrupting the Aegis network edge. Stabilise the service, preserve critical bandwidth and bring the network back online.
briefing: Multiple simulated service endpoints are receiving an abnormal volume of traffic. The infrastructure is under pressure. Analyse the traffic pattern, apply defensive rate controls and restore critical service availability.

objectives.title: Analyse abnormal traffic
objectives.description: Inspect network telemetry and identify the simulated traffic flood.

objectives.title: Apply traffic rate limits
objectives.description: Contain the flood by enforcing a defensive ingress policy.

objectives.title: Reroute critical traffic
objectives.description: Prioritise trusted service traffic through the resilient route.

objectives.title: Restore service availability
objectives.description: Bring the affected simulated service back to a healthy state.

objectives.title: Submit the recovery report
objectives.description: Document the mitigation steps and close the incident.
